guide.summary: Lets linked colony members pass spare food and energy to hungry neighbours.
guide.biology: Some real cells that grow in chains pass nutrients to one another through tiny connections.
guide.rules: Costs 0.02 energy per second while carried. Needs Colony adhesion and works only on links where both ends carry it. Carbon: a member above 1.25 times its starting body sends up to 0.01 × starting body per second to a linked member below 1.25 times its own, paying 1 energy per carbon sent; the receiver pays nothing. Energy: a member above 70 energy sends up to 0.5 energy per second to a linked member below 40; only 90 % arrives and 10 % is lost. A member that gives energy receives none in the same step, and nothing is passed along further in that step.
guide.example: Stretch a chain of linked Sprinters across the edge of a sugar patch and see whether members outside the sugar stay fed.
